description.en: Drag the upper-right notch to peel open a solid 3D foil pouch. Stop halfway, regrab the bent strip and finish tearing to release the powder.
description.zh: 从右上角拖开立体金属包装，可停在半途并继续拉动弯折封条，完全撕开后释放抹茶粉末。

keywords: 包装 撕开 撕口 抹茶 粉末 粒子 消散 金属 产品 package tear matcha powder reveal Andreas

discovery.caveat: 本地程序化产品动效；无真实商品购买或上传功能。

source.implementation: Independent procedural Three.js foil geometry, Canvas lettering, staged surface erosion, mass-dependent Gaussian grain transport and instanced turbulent dust, with tear-velocity feedback, scoped lifecycle and a Canvas2D fallback.
source.license: Original design/model/source license not supplied or independently verified. No reference video, screenshots, original 3D assets or proprietary fonts are redistributed. Embedded Inter retains OFL and controls retain the Lucide MIT notice.

notice.en: Complete source files from this project's existing framework package. Preserve included notices and reference attribution.
notice.zh: 提供本站已有框架代码包的完整文件，保留源码声明与设计参考署名。

instructions.en: Grab the upper-right notch and drag left to tear. Release halfway and continue from the strip. Move over the pouch to tilt it; R resets and Enter on the notch opens it.
instructions.zh: 抓住右上角向左拖动撕开，中途松手后可从封条继续。鼠标移动可查看立体反光；R 重置，聚焦撕口后按 Enter 打开。
